AN INSTANT NEW YORK TIMES BESTSELLER

From global bestseller Jasmine Mas comes a brand-new story of obsession that asks…

When the hunter is hunted, who becomes prey?

SHE IS THE EMPEROR’S ENEMY

Knight Mage and Bear of the North Zora Ravenal is her people’s only hope against the ravenous empire.

HE IS THE HUNTER’S MARK

Emperor and royal mage Aleksander the Sadistic is hellbent on possessing Zora and smothering the rebellion.

WHO WILL KNEEL FIRST?

With the world at his command – including Tarantula, the deadliest assassin in the empire’s arsenal – Aleksander will stop at nothing to satisfy his obsession. But the emperor has made one mistake … Zora is hunting them too.

'A five star read, dripping in blood. Adored!' Brigitte Knightley, Sunday Times bestselling author of The Irresistible Urge to Fall for Your Enemy

'Wow! Jasmine Mas does it again with an exhilarating tale that will leave you breathless. Exciting, romantic, and filled with Mas's trademark wit, The Emperor's Enemy is a breath of fresh air' Elizabeth Helen, Sunday Times bestselling author of Bonded by Thorns

'Jasmine Mas continues to prove why she’s one of my all time favourite authors with The Emperor’s Enemy' S.J. Tilly, New York Times bestselling author of the Alliance series

'One of my favourite reads of all time' 5* Reader Review

'The banter, the slow burn, the female rage, the cute little owl, and that ending?!?!! I loved it all!' 5* Reader Review

About the author

JASMINE MAS is a Sunday Times and New York Times bestselling author of fantasy romance. Her books have been translated into over 20 languages. She has a degree in ancient Greco-Roman classical studies from Georgetown University and is a former lawyer who spends all her free time writing about strong women in magical worlds. She lives with her husband and cat named Boo. Jasmine loves connecting with readers on TikTok and Instagram at @jasminemasbooks. jasminemasbooks.com
